findings.body: Live reviewer metadata comes exclusively from the configured values written at run start (review.py:512 and board.py:273–275). Autoreview's reported `model:` and `thinking:` values, including its fallback-model announcement, update only `selected` at review.py:604–610; this progress record publishes only `step`. Consequently, a valid configuration without review metadata leaves model/effort null throughout the review, and a fallback keeps displaying the unavailable model. This affects both reviewer providers. Publish the reported selection into live run metadata and consume it in both views. The new reviewer tests explicitly configure both values and never emit selection or fallback messages, so they cannot detect this gap.
findings.title: Not done: each running reviewer's actual model and effort
